title: Two debts replaced by one payment at year 1
caption: At time 1, £1,000 due now has grown to £1,050, and £2,000 due at time 2 is worth £1,904.76 one year earlier. Moving every amount to the same date lets them be added: £2,954.76.
alt: One bar split into £1,050 (the debt due now, accumulated) and £1,904.76 (the debt due at year 2, discounted), with a bracket over both for £2,954.76.
description: Choose time 1 as the comparison date.
The £1,000 due now accumulates one year: 1000 × 1.05 = £1,050.
The £2,000 due at year 2 is discounted one year: 2000/1.05 = £1,904.76.
Add the two values at the same date: £2,954.76.
